title: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
summary: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public. CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight. "We intend to continue with AI progress … but as the models have had this surge forward
reason: Altman's statement about delaying an OpenAI IPO is executive commentary with no actual financing/M&A/deal, no model release, no research artifact, no policy action, and no OSS tool. No active rule covers it.
